newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Paribas starts Brazil power cos.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Paribas starts Brazil power cos.

text.p: -- Paribas Capital Markets analyst Lawson Steele started coverage of the Brazilian electric power sector on Friday.

-- Steele set buy ratings for: Companhia de Eletricidade do Rio de Janeiro, or Cerj ; Eletropaulo ; Light Servicos de Eletricidade SA ; Companhia Energetica de Sao Paulo, or CESP ; Centrais Eletricas Brasileiras SA, or Eletrobras ; and LightPar.
-- He set a hold rating for Companhia Paranaense de Energia SA, or Copel, and sell ratings for Companhia Paulista de Forca e Luz SA, or CPFL and Companhia Energetica de Minas Gerais, or Cemig.
-- Steel set an overweight recommendation for the sector.

-- "Despite outperformance of 19 percent in the last six months, we believe the sector should rise by 35 percent in absolute terms and outperform the market by seven percent over the next 12 months," he wrote in an analysis.
-- "An increase in generation tariffs would enhance these targets even further."
-- "... Privatizations and auctions to date have been carried out at significant premiums to market prices indicating the pent-up demand for Brazilian electricity companies."
